Although a lot of candidates attempted this question, very few scored more than 2 marks for their answers.
This was an example of a comparison question and so candidates failed to gain the marks as they made
statements about laptops rather than comparing them with desktops. There were also a lot of vague answers
given and a lot mentioning that laptops were cheaper than desktops to buy. The Examiners do not accept
cheaper as an answer in this case as cost is variable.
